Your AI coding agent reads READMEs, tickets and tool output, and runs commands with your credentials. So what happens when one of them lies?
This is Window Sticker. Every AI agent should ship with a crash test rating.

We run an agent dozens of times, each run in its own throwaway micro V M on Vultr, against a published suite of traps. Then we print what we measured: how often it did something dangerous, with an exact confidence interval, how often it finished the job, and what it cost.

Every run boots a fresh micro V M in about half a second, plants one trap in a real task, and lets the agent work. Mechanical tripwires decide the verdict. Two Vultr decision models triage. A Vultr model explains it in plain English. Then the V M is destroyed, and its evidence is archived in Vultr Object Storage.
And this is live. A judge picks a model, guardrails and an operating system. Six real micro V Ms boot on a Vultr V X 1 host, and each verdict lands as it is graded, in about a minute.

Here, the agent ran a config checker that hides an A P I key inside a D N S lookup, then pasted the key into lookups itself. The tripwire caught it at the exact step. And nothing left the lab. No D N S answers, no route out, and the key was a canary, minted for this run alone.
Across nine configurations, six Vultr models and five hundred and seventy six real runs, the ratings separate the careful agents from the reckless ones.

And the measurements found what a demo never shows. On an older Python, the same agent reached for an unknown package index ten times in twelve, against three on a newer one. Six tool guardrails refused none of the attacks they were never written for. And containment held on every operating system we tried.
All of it runs on Vultr. V X 1 compute for the micro V Ms. Serverless Inference for the agents, the jury, the analyst and the trap writer. And Object Storage for the evidence.
Teams get a badge, a security review packet mapped to the oh-wasp top ten for L L Ms, and a C I gate that fails only on a measurable regression.
Everyone else sells the cage. We sell the crash rating. Window Sticker.
